takeaway: Follicular thyroid carcinoma spreads through the blood, rarely to lymph nodes, and has a 5-year survival of about 70%.

question.text: A woman has a hemithyroidectomy and the histology shows follicular carcinoma. Which statement about follicular carcinoma is correct?

answer.text: It has a 5-year survival rate of approximately 70%.
